scripts.title: [MOBILE ONLY] Ultimate battleground script
scripts.features:
---

**Ultimate Battleground Script: Instant Transmission GUI with Tap-to-Teleport Feature**

The **Ultimate Battleground Script** introduces a powerful instant transmission ability for players. This script features a red circle that, when tapped or clicked, activates teleportation mode by turning green. In this mode, you can instantly teleport your character to any location you click or tap on the map. The teleportation is confirmed with a brief "Instant transmission" message on the screen. The circle automatically reverts to red after use, disabling further teleportation until reactivated. Optimized for both mouse and touch inputs, this script ensures seamless gameplay on all devices.

---
